newsitem.title: USA: Revlon holding co's defeasement boosts debt.
newsitem.headline: Revlon holding co's defeasement boosts debt.

text.p: Revlon Worldwide Corp's senior secured discount notes due 1998 popped more than one point on Friday after the company said it plans to defease the issue, traders said.
The debt was quoted as high as 93-1/2 bid, 94 offer at mid-morning compared with a 92-1/4 bid at Thursday's close, one trader said. Another shop quoted a 93 bid, no offer.
In terms of spread, the debt tightened from about 260 basis points over Treasuries to 100 basis points over. Traders expected the debt to move into the 50 to 75 basis point range over the next year.
Revlon Worldwide said it will raise funds to defease the debt through a new issuance of zero coupon bonds and a capital infusion by MacAndrews & Forbes Holdings Inc.
A spokesman for MacAndrews & Forbes declined to comment on the timing or the size of the proposed debt issue.
